pages.title: Thylacosmilus
pages.text: $(o)Thylacosmilus$() ($(o)Thylacosmilus atrox$()) is an extinct predator that lived in South America from the Late Miocene to the Pliocene, until about 3 million years ago.$(br2)Though it looked like a sabre-toothed cat, it was not a cat at all, but a sparassodont, a relative of marsupials.$(br2)Its huge, ever-growing upper canines were protected by long bony flanges on the lower jaw.
